email.subject: Availability enquiry for CLOVER FEATURE FILM
email.text:
Thank you! We have successfully recorded your response.


Please respond to this availability enquiry as soon as possible, it will automatically expire by now




'CLOVER' IS A NEW MAJOR FEATURE FILM - THIS IS A HUGE PROJECT WITH SOME BIG NAMES
ATTACHED - due to confidentiality we cannot say much more at this stage but please be assured
that this is a VERY BIG & GREAT film to be a part of.

PLEASE MAY YOU READ THE BELOW INFORMATION VERY CAREFULLY - THERE IS A LOT OF INFO!




ROLE: A BUSINESS MAN AT US AIRPORT
These are to fulfil some exciting scenes filming an airport scene!



Some scenes may involve running and jostling with other people so please do only mark yourself available if happy to take part in these elements.



THESE SCENES ARE SET IN THE EARLY 60S - AS SUCH IT MAY REQUIRE A HAIRCUT TO MATCH THE PERIOD OF THE FILM - PLEASE NOTE THAT
THIS IS FOR A SHORT BACK AND SIDES FROM THE 1960S, it is nothing drastic but MUST be willing to have short back and sides for the role.



DATES: (PLEASE NOTE THERE ARE LIKELY TO BE MORE DATES IN THE FUTURE ON THIS - IT IS A LONG RUNNING PRODUCTION)
 DATES FOR THIS ROLE:


FITTING:
YOU WILL BE REQUIRED TO HAVE A COSTUME FITTING PRIOR TO FILMING DUE TO THE PRODUCTIONS PERIOD. YOU WILL LIKLEY REQUIRE A
HAIRCUT AT YOUR FITTING.

TOMORROW! FRIDAY 14TH AUGUST

FITTINGS WILL TAKE PLACE IN BOVINGDON STUDIOS - PARKING WILL BE AVAILABLE OR PICK UP FROM A STATION PROVIDED.

BOVINGDON STUDIOS IS SITUATED NEAR HEMEL HEMPSTEAD STATION WHICH IS ROUGHLY A 25 MINUTE TRAIN FROM LONDON EUSTON -
ROUGH TIME SLOTS ARE BETWEEN 8AM - 4PM



FILMING:
Please note these are likely to be early morning call times - filming is at Sandown Racecourse so much be able to get to this location for an early
call. Parking and local/central London pick ups available.


Wednesday 19th August



Please note that some scenes may have atmos/smoke used



PLEASE KNOW THESE ARE SOME VERY VERY COOL SCENES AND A VERY EXCITING PROJECT
TO BE A PART OF!


FAA UNION RATES!
 Project: CLOVER FEATURE FILM
Dates: AS PER ABOVE
Location: AS ABOVE
Rate: FAA RATES
Fees: 10% commission plus VAT and Entertainment Partners admin fee of 10% plus VAT



(If you have any questions about the terms used above, please check our FAQ (https://key-casting.uk.epcastingportal.com/faq))




      Questions
   Please answer the following questions.

          Are you free tomorrow for a costume fitting? time slots between 8am and 4pm at Bovingdon Studios

          Please indicate if you can be fully available for filming
